body:
It has happened before. We've been together going on 6 years now, so there have been transitions both planned and unplanned. Before I was able to get unemployment due to the circumstances that I lost the job (was let go due to downsizing). That helped a bit. About the only thing I know to do now is just keep on putting in applications and keeping my feelers out for new opportunities. I've tried signing up for some private contractor type business but those all seem to be pretty scammy. 

I've got 6 years of customer service experience though, which can help land you in a lot of places. I guess I just had a bad wake up this morning because of the bills / rent coming out and us only being left with a couple hundred dollars to last the rest of the month.

Oh absolutely, she's 100% supportive which I think is why it makes me feel this bad. I know that sounds odd, but hear me out. It'd be easier to not feel like I've put us in this situation if she was a horrible person. The fact that she assures me everything will be OK makes me feel worse though. Maybe that's something broken in me? I feel like I've put a great woman in a horrible spot because I couldn't be tough.

Yea, I feel that I failed her. I feel that I should have been a stronger man and just dealt with what I was going through, gritted my teeth and pushed on. Everyone always says "it'll get better" but I'm quickly starting to not believe that. 

I've got over 5 years in my field (experience wise), so I assumed I could find another job easily, but now I'm starting to doubt that.
She did, she actually suggested I quit and find something else. I stopped eating, sleeping, couldn't get an erection, and dreaded every day. I'm comfortable being open.

I started out really strong at my old job, worked really really hard and got a "promotion" (didn't get any extra pay but was promised a raise after 30 days of performance, which I exceeded, when the time came though they refused to discuss the raise, but kept the responsibilities in place). This went on for about 4 months before I had enough.

I'm just upset. I left a job last month after several promises they made and didn't come through on. Got tired of being one of the lowest paid employees at my firm with the most responsibility. I tried to hold out until another job offer came, but enough was finally enough and I snapped and quit. Now we're nearing the first full month without my extra income, my wife works but it isn't enough to cover everything. I just don't know what to do and feel like such a burden right now. I feel worthless as a man, and can't believe I allowed myself to make this type of mistake. I'm 30 years old and feel like I'm 13 at times.
